outcome.understanding: Yale AI Club requests 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies, size M, and a bulk discount. The ticket has no invoice or prior approval. The requested quantity exceeds on-hand stock, and both a discount and restock PO are pending human approval. A customer message draft is saved but must be sent by a human.

assignments.task: Check stock for 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY size M and identify the shortfall; then arrange restock with Accounting for any shortfall, after checking for duplicate approvals.
assignments.why: Inventory has stock, shortfall and vendor/restock coordination tools.

assignments.task: Identify list price, unit cost and the lowest permissible price / largest discount within the minimum margin for the requested order; no target discount was supplied.
assignments.why: Accounting has margin and discount-approval capabilities. It also queued the proposed discount approval.

assignments.task: Draft a reply reflecting the stock shortfall and pending restock and discount approvals, without promising fulfillment or price.
assignments.why: Customer_service is equipped to draft customer messages.

outcome.decision: Inventory found 8 on hand and a shortfall of 12. Purchase order #1 for 12 units from Bulldog Print Co for $264.00 is pending approval, with estimated arrival 2026-09-05. Accounting found list price $58.00 and unit cost $22.00; discount approval #3 proposes $31.43 per hoodie ($628.60 total), the lowest price that meets the 30.0% minimum margin, and is pending approval. This discount was queued although the customer did not specify a target discount. Accounting warned cash would be −$104.00 after all pending obligations; consider that before approving the purchase order. Draft message #2 is saved; a human must send it. Do not promise availability or price until the relevant approvals are decided.
pending_approvals: Approval #3: discount to $31.43 per hoodie, $628.60 total.
